title: Shadowed Figure with Phone
description: A mysterious figure stands in complete darkness, holding a black smartphone with both hands to completely obscure their face. The hands have long, manicured nails with red tips, emerging from a dark garment against a glowing, irregular red rectangular frame that has a dripping, molten texture.
prompt: A mysterious figure in total darkness holds a black smartphone with both hands directly in front of their face, completely hiding it from view. The hands have long fingernails painted with red tips. The figure is framed by an irregular, glowing red rectangular border with a dripping molten texture, creating a stark and ominous composition against a deep black background.
